objective: Build and freeze a reproducible Binance Data Vision Spot archive inventory for historical USDT-suffix symbols and 1h monthly objects without downloading Kline ZIP payloads.
git_status_reason: Prior completed experiment artifacts and repository progress documentation are intentionally uncommitted in the same user-authorized research turn.
market: Binance Spot public archive inventory only
symbol_filter: archive CommonPrefix symbol string ends with USDT
symbol_filter_semantics: SYMBOL_SUFFIX_USDT_CANDIDATE, not proven historical quoteAsset metadata
deferred_hypothesis: Weekly 28-day skip-1 residual momentum with a 90-day BTC beta, allowed only after an independent PIT panel and eligibility experiment passes.

formal_run.failure: Frozen ASCII-only symbol validation rejected five observed Unicode archive symbol prefixes; no per-symbol object listing, exchangeInfo request, ZIP payload, or CHECKSUM payload was performed.

notes: An archive object inventory reduces current-survivor selection but does not establish historical tradability, listing/delisting time, bar coverage, order executability, or a backtest-ready point-in-time panel. The failed live run is preserved and is not reused as a completed inventory.
